prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-57210 from Fennick Analytics
prose.body:
Hi Greywater Robotics team,

Hope you’re having a great week! This is just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-57210 for 560.34 USDC. We know things get busy, so we wanted to make sure this didn’t slip through the cracks.

To settle the balance, please send the payment to our standard receiving wallet: 0x49830c8e3ab294939a8fd713b82a05ab619fb857. This is the same address you’ve used for previous transactions, so it should already be in your records.

Once the transfer is made, our system will automatically update your account status. If you’ve already sent this payment, please disregard this note and consider it confirmation that we’ve received your notice.

Let us know if you have any questions or need a copy of the invoice again. We appreciate your partnership and look forward to continuing our work together.

Best regards,

Fennick Analytics Billing Team
